prompts.world_atlas: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background artwork for an interactive dark fantasy RPG world atlas. Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its richly illustrated antique golden parchment, sepia pen hatching, muted olive pine forests, blue-green rivers, crisp miniature mountains and worn irregular paper rim. Create a NEW geographically much larger coherent continent chart, landscape 16:9. Four large recognizable provinces: southwest temperate pastoral Marches with a walled river town, a broken-cart road and mine in foothills; northwest dense Blackwood forest with ruined abbey and ford; northeast Iron Highlands with a mountain pass, stone fortress and quarry; southeast Ashen Coast with an inlet, salt harbor and ruined lighthouse. A linked river and overland road network makes this ONE continuous landscape; separate biomes gently through mountain ridges/rivers, no hard grid or panel boundaries. The Marches should occupy roughly bottom-left quadrant, Blackwood upper-left, highlands upper-right, coast lower-right. High-detail engraved terrain but calm open land around provincial centers for code-rendered labels. Top-down cartography with small oblique miniature landmarks as in reference, not aerial photography. Restrained dark fantasy, believable geography, subtle weathering, no giant skulls, no UI chrome. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, labels, route markers, buttons, legend or colored territory polygons. A single small compass rose in top left margin. Opaque landscape full map, no mockup.

Generate a NEW closer-scale map of BLACKWOOD province: continuous dense ancient pine forest cut by a winding river running from top middle towards bottom middle. Five landmarks with precise approximate normalized centers needed for clickable game map: a ruined sunken stone abbey at (0.32,0.25); overgrown ruined walls at (0.78,0.22); a shallow ford in river at (0.59,0.47); a small forester camp of cabins at (0.25,0.68); a charcoal and timber gate camp at (0.78,0.78). Match reference luminous antique ink illustration with restrained dark fantasy atmosphere, not muddy black. Map fills landscape with slim irregular paper edge, compass small at top-left, NO text, letters, numbers, UI, buttons, map pins, hard divisions or labels. Distinct geographically coherent place, rich hand-engraved cartography, crisp natural texture.
